_comment: Feature access matrix (23 Nov 2026): Free THB 0, Paid THB 399/month, Premium THB 599/month. Read by api/_tiers.js (server, authoritative) and app/src/lib/entitlements.js (display only). Demo is a non-billable preview and never appears in a feature list. A route not listed here keeps its existing Free entitlement.

marketRotation.title: Market rotation
marketRotation.summary: Relative strength across sectors and styles, measured against the S&P 500.

marketIntel.title: Market intelligence
marketIntel.summary: The daily AI-labelled market briefing built from public headlines, with impact and reasoning per story.

riskAppetite.title: Risk appetite
riskAppetite.summary: XLY/XLP consumer risk appetite, VIX and VIXEQ implied dispersion history.

valuation.title: Intrinsic value and margin of safety
valuation.summary: DCF and residual-income models for every holding, margin of safety, valuation dispersion and history.

deepAnalysis.title: Holdings deep analysis
deepAnalysis.summary: One holding at a time: price, position, risk, valuation, analyst revisions and headlines.

analyst.title: Ask the analyst
analyst.summary: Questions about your own portfolio answered from your live positions, weights, P&L, concentration and drawdown.

briefing.title: Daily briefing
briefing.summary: A written summary of what moved, what changed and what to watch in your portfolio today.

sectorRotation.title: Sector rotation
sectorRotation.summary: Relative rotation graph, leadership quality, earnings revisions and sector breadth.

council.title: LLM council
council.summary: Five analytical perspectives and a CEO synthesis, written by one model in one structured report.

councilReports.title: AI research reports
councilReports.summary: Your saved LLM council reports, available to reread and to the research agent.

simulation.title: Simulation engine
simulation.summary: Monte Carlo portfolio scenarios, return distributions, stress tests and the Projection Lab.
